summary: The agent assisted with a credit card limit increase request.

intents.keywords: मेरा क्रेडिट कार्ड लिमिट क्यों काम हो गया?...इसे वापस 2 लाख करें।
intents.actions of agent: The agent checked the customer's card details, confirmed the limit adjustment, and submitted a request to increase the limit.
intents.Process Request: Request to increase credit card limit to 2 lakh.
intents.resolution: The agent submitted a request to increase the credit card limit, which will be updated in 3-5 days.
